mapper.select: SELECT Af_Num AS afNum, Af_Seq AS afSeq, Af_Flag AS afFlag, Af_FileName AS afFileName, Af_FileSize AS afFileSize, CONVERT(varchar (19), Af_RegDate, 120) AS afRegDate, Af_UserID AS afUserId, CONVERT(varchar (4), YEAR (Af_RegDate)) AS saveYear, RIGHT ('0'+ CONVERT (varchar (2), MONTH (Af_RegDate)), 2) AS saveMonth FROM File_DB.dbo.i_addFile WHERE Af_Num=#{afNum} ORDER BY Af_Seq

SELECT Af_Num AS afNum, Af_Seq AS afSeq, Af_Flag AS afFlag, Af_FileName AS afFileName, Af_FileSize AS afFileSize, CONVERT(varchar (19), Af_RegDate, 120) AS afRegDate, Af_UserID AS afUserId, CONVERT(varchar (4), YEAR (Af_RegDate)) AS saveYear, RIGHT ('0'+ CONVERT (varchar (2), MONTH (Af_RegDate)), 2) AS saveMonth FROM File_DB.dbo.i_addFile WHERE Af_Num=#{afNum} AND Af_Seq=#{afSeq}
